ruleset.name: Quality Suite - JSP
ruleset.description: PMD JSP rules for legacy JSP: security, error-prone and duplicate imports. Rules that fire on almost every legacy page are left out: NoScriptlets, NoInlineScript, NoLongScripts and NoUnsanitizedJSPExpression (every ${...} without c:out). Add them in the rules file when a code base is ready, e.g. "category/jsp/security.xml/NoUnsanitizedJSPExpression": true.
